office_does: The three Garfield County commissioners adopt the county budget, set county policy and ordinances, and oversee roads, property and services; this seat is for the two years left in the term.
race_blurb: Appointed Commissioner Vonda (Vonni) Mulrony, chosen in February 2026 after Jim Nelson resigned, faces Beau Blachly, a farm-supply sales manager on the county planning commission. Mulrony led the district-only primary 186 to 119; every county voter votes in November.

candidates.summary: Appointed District 1 commissioner since February 2026, the first woman to serve on the board; a dental hygienist, dental hygiene professor and insurance agent by career, who has served on the school, hospital district, health and equalization boards.
highlights: Appointed in February 2026 to fill the vacant District 1 seat; first woman on the board [S2]
Lists the Pomeroy School District, Hospital District, Board of Health and Board of Equalization [S1]
Says 'strong financial oversight, and steady, informed leadership are essential' [S1]

experience.basis: The sitting commissioner (by appointment since February 2026) with several local board seats, running to keep the seat; a short tenure in this office, so not -2.

spending.basis: Single clear statement leading with 'strong financial oversight' and steady leadership; no spending or program-expansion plank.

candidates.summary: Agribusiness sales manager, Pomeroy conservation district vice chair and county planning commissioner, running on a balanced long-term budget, county services and property owners' rights.
highlights: 15 years a WinField United sales area manager after 14 years at Pomeroy Grain Growers [S1]
Vice chair of the Pomeroy Soil and Water Conservation District; on the county planning commission [S1]
Would build 'long term balanced budget funding' to keep road and emergency services at a high standard [S1]
States 'a firm commitment to the rights of property owners large and small' [S1]

experience.basis: Challenger who has never held county office; runs on a private-sector agribusiness career, with only conservation district and planning commission service in public roles.

spending.basis: Pairs a long-term balanced budget with keeping road and emergency services at a high standard: restraint and service continuity in one sentence.
